title: Installed app page: after a reload, show how many sample records are left (read the new server count) instead of only yes/no
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

Filing gate: ① the console half of a server change, named in ui#6's release of #30323 (comment on #30323, 2026-11-05T16:17Z: "that console change, if any, comes back to `domain:ui` as its own card"). ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3. ⛔ Serial after PR #30613 merges (the server read this card consumes).
Dedupe: `sample data count console`, `withSampleData count`. Nearest: #30323 (its ui half landed in PR #30537; its server half is PR #30613). **New.**

## What happens

Since PR #30537, the console says how many sample records an install loaded and offers Clear sample data, but only for an install made in the current browser session. After a reload it knows only the list's `withSampleData` yes/no, so the banner and the clear confirm cannot say how many records will go.

## What the server now offers (once PR #30613 lands)

`GET /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId/sample-data` answers `{ manifestId, count, unidentified }`: `count` is exactly the number of rows a purge would delete right now (same matcher, same keep-rules), `unidentified` the seed records the purge would report and not delete. Same permission as the purge (`manage_metadata`); `0` for a package without samples.

## Ask

On the marketplace package page and the sample-data banner, read the count on any visit (not only after an in-session install), so the confirm says "N records will be deleted" from the server's number. Keep the in-session install count as today when it is fresher. Pin: a reload shows the server count; `count: 0` hides the banner.

Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` and the banner PR #30537 added).
